title: ExtensionSidebar width constants live in constants.ts, not ExtensionSidebar.tsx
answers: Why is there a circular dependency between AppChrome, ExtensionSidebar, and ExtensionSidebarProvider?
body: MIN_EXTENSION_SIDEBAR_WIDTH, MAX_EXTENSION_SIDEBAR_WIDTH, and DEFAULT_EXTENSION_SIDEBAR_WIDTH were moved from ExtensionSidebar.tsx into public/app/core/components/AppChrome/ExtensionSidebar/constants.ts. This breaks a cycle where AppChrome.tsx, ExtensionSidebar.tsx, and ExtensionSidebarProvider.tsx all imported from each other. Import these width constants from './ExtensionSidebar/constants', not from './ExtensionSidebar/ExtensionSidebar'.
